playback_status: comparison.mp4 and cartoon.mp4 are present, but actual normal-speed playback was unavailable through my viewing surface. I inspected still images only; no motion approval is inferred.

original_doodle_identity: The angular outline, two short slanted eye marks, uneven polygon ears, outline-only body spots and simple bent smile preserve recognizable parts of the supplied doodle.

The dominant muzzle-to-head proportion is lost. In design.png the wide, flat polygon muzzle extends conspicuously beyond both sides of the narrow head. In all ten keys the muzzle is narrower than the enlarged tall head, producing a different face silhouette.
The open keys turn that already-small muzzle into a downward pouch. The broad, flat muzzle is the clearest identity feature to restore.
source_framing_and_pose: The supplied keys keep the source close frontal head-and-shoulders crop, with ears near the upper edge and the body cut by the lower edge.
The initial slant followed by a more centered frontal head is visible in both source and keys. The source open-versus-closed jaw states have corresponding drawing states in the supplied samples.
These stills establish sampled framing and pose correspondence, not the timing, continuity or naturalness of the action.
observations.inspection_scope: Read source.json and visually inspected source-contact-sheet.jpg, design.png, source-01.jpg through source-10.jpg, key-01.png through key-10.png, paired-keys-01.jpg and paired-keys-02.jpg. Did not inspect implementation, notes or other reviews.

most_important_gap: Original-doodle identity: the broad flat muzzle has become a small muzzle beneath a much wider, taller head.

Keep its top edge and broad polygon character stable while the lower edge and simple mouth mark articulate the sampled jaw openings.
